title: Hollow Parish: Dead Frequency
description: ??? Serve Customers Fast! Awesome “Ice Breaker” and “Speed & Serve”  Arcade-Style Games ?? Create & Serve Dozens of Delicious & Unique Ice Cream out of Your Own Ice Cream Truck from Outer Space to NYC?? Decorate Ice Cream with Wacky & Wild Costumes & Candies!   Here’s the scoop, your ice cream truck is waiting and it’s time to make some fantastic ice cream to serve to your customers! Arcade-style games will keep you on your toes, timing you as you break ice cubes and serve your kid customers quickly. Make sure you get the order right!  ICE BREAKER GAME! CRUNCH! First you need to break up 15 chunks of ice and FAST! The clock is ticking. Break up the cubes in 60 seconds or less! I SCREAM, YOU SCREAMNow it’s time to make your ice cream. You will add milk, cream, crack an egg and mix it all up. Choose from 18 delicious flavors. Mix in your flavor and then combine the ice with your sweet mixture. Put in a bowl and stick it in the freezer. A clock will tell you when the ice cream is ready.  ICE CREAM DECORATEChoose a fun cone or cup and create silly faces on your ice cream. Put on some wild hair, a mustache, crazy lips and a bow tie. Then decorate your ice cream creation with some candy, Gummi Bears and chocolates. SHARE & SAVEWhen you’re finished creating the coolest, most awesome ice cream ever, take a photo with our camera and email it to friends and family! You can save your photos in your own special photo gallery. SPEED & SERVE GAMENow it’s time to QUICKLY serve your customers. But make sure you give them the correct ice cream cone.The kids will make a happy face and thumbs up if you did a good job. Get the wrong order and you get a sad face. Check the “happiness meter” to see how well you’re doing. Make ice cream & discover exotic places around the world, under the sea and even outer space! Hurry up, your customers are waiting. The more ice cream you make the more places you get to visit.What's inside:? 18 delicious flavors ? 22 different cones & cups? 125 dress up including hats, hair, silly lips, mustaches, bow ties & sunglasses? 100 candies to decorate your ice cream ? 15 customers to serve Features:? Break up blocks of ice with the tap of your finger - like an arcade game! ? Serve the correct flavors to your customers - and FAST - a clock is ticking!? Reset button lets you make ice cream over again and re-decorate? Replace let’s you change flavors? “Happiness Meter” tells you how well you’re doing serving your customers ? Gallery of ice cream creations - keeps photos of all you make? Rotate - changes the angle and size of each ice cream decoration & candyABOUT TabTale:Search “TabTale” on iTunes and get to know more apps for young kids.TabTales’ apps are filled with engaging activities.
